description:
An access control operation defines a specific action that can be performed on a resource in Port OS. Operations are namespaced under port1/systems/zero/operations/ and follow kebab-case naming conventions. Each operation corresponds to a specific API endpoint or resource action that requires authorization.
Operations are organized into the following categories:
**Flow Operations**: Control access to flows (workflow definitions) and their execution runs. - flow-read: Read flow definitions and metadata - flow-write: Create or modify flow definitions - flow-delete: Delete flow definitions - flow-send-message: Send messages to flows to trigger execution
**Flow Run Operations**: Control access to individual flow execution instances. - flow-run-read: Read flow run status, logs, and results - flow-run-write: Modify flow run configuration or state - flow-run-delete: Delete flow run records - flow-run-message: Send messages to active flow runs - flow-run-lifecyle-stop: Stop a running flow execution - flow-run-lifecyle-start: Start or resume a flow execution
**Endpoint Operations**: Control access to endpoints (devices, services, or other resources). - endpoint-read: Read endpoint information and metadata - endpoint-write: Create or modify endpoints - endpoint-delete: Delete endpoints
**Message Operations**: Control message sending and receiving capabilities. - endpoints-message-send: Send messages to endpoints - endpoints-message-receive: Receive messages from endpoints
**Plugin Operations**: Control access to plugin configurations and integrations. - plugin-read: Read plugin definitions and configurations - plugin-write: Create or modify plugins - plugin-delete: Delete plugins - plugin-establish-auth-link: Establish authentication links for plugins - plugin-auth-code-exchange: Exchange a code for an access token - plugin-auth-multifactor-exchange: Request a multifactor authentication code
**Route Operations**: Control access to routes (control interfaces for endpoints). - route-read: Read route configurations and metadata - route-write: Create or modify routes - route-delete: Delete routes - route-synchronize: Synchronize routes with external systems
**Auth Link Operations**: Control access to authentication link configurations. - auth-link-read: Read authentication link configurations - auth-link-write: Create or modify authentication links - auth-link-delete: Delete authentication links
**Principal Operations**: Control access to principal (user, endpoint, service) management. - principal-read: Read principal information - principal-write: Create or modify principals - principal-delete: Delete principals
**Secret Operations**: Control access to stored secrets and credentials. - secret-read: Read secret values and metadata - secret-write: Create or modify secrets - secret-update-tokens: Update OAuth tokens stored in secrets - secret-delete: Delete secrets - secret-refresh-token: Refresh OAuth tokens in secrets
**Access Control Rule Operations**: Control access to permission rules themselves. - access-control-rule-read: Read access control rules - access-control-rule-write: Create or modify access control rules - access-control-rule-delete: Delete access control rules
**Subscription Operations**: Control access to event subscriptions. - subscription-read: Read subscription configurations - subscription-write: Create or modify subscriptions - subscription-delete: Delete subscriptions
**View Operations**: Control access to views (dashboard configurations). - view-read: Read view definitions and configurations - view-write: Create or modify views - view-delete: Delete views
